samples.identification: StormAttack resource-DLL injector with damaged embedded payload
evidence: PE entry 0x402674 calls WinMain 0x401cb0. Mode DWORD at VA 0x404120 is 3; startup branches to 0x401900 then self-delete at 0x401390.

0x401900 generates a GUID, constructs an executable copy path and HKLM Active Setup Installed Components key, writes REG_EXPAND_SZ StubPath at 0x401a4b, reads its own image through CRT I/O, patches the buffer, writes a copy and launches it at 0x401b7e.
0x401390 gets the current module short path, reads COMSPEC, builds /c del <self> > nul and starts the shell with CreateProcessA.
DLL resource type DLL, id 101, language 2052, at file offset 0x5060, length 39936. Function 0x402460 extracts it and calls the file writer.

0x401150 creates a selected host process (iexplore.exe/notepad.exe/calc.exe), allocates remote memory for the DLL path, writes it, resolves kernel32!LoadLibraryA, then passes the resolved EAX and remote buffer ESI to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
Alternate mode 1 calls 0x401260: opens HKLM LanmanServer Parameters, deletes ServiceDLL and writes replacement expandable DLL path. This branch is present but not selected by the current mode.
StormServer.dll, Storm ddos Server, welcome banner and embedded STORM command-format strings corroborate family identity.
limits: Embedded DLL entry RVA 0x741a maps to zero bytes; no executable sections or recoverable import table. Only 2200 of 39936 bytes are nonzero. Do not infer working DDoS, downloading, or spying from remaining strings.
Surviving loader code is malicious despite damaged payload. Successful installation or injection was not observed.
Self-copy patches fixed original-file offsets; this reconstructed layout may prevent the copy from switching modes correctly.
Collection filename mentioning elex/remcos/wannacry supplies no family evidence.
Triage URL could not be retrieved; verdict rests on bytes and traced execution paths.
samples.reason: Self-copy autostart plus self-deletion and DLL-injection/service-hijack code establish a covert implant installer.
